paper_title: First results of axion dark matter search with DANCE
notes: First results from DANCE Act-1 bow-tie optical cavity axion DM search (24-hour observation, May 2021). Paper sets 95% CL upper limit g_agamma <~ 8e-4 GeV^-1 over 1e-14 eV < ma < 1e-13 eV, quoted as approximately flat in text/abstract; the full mass-dependent limit is only shown in Fig. 6 (not tabulated), so a two-point flat bound over the stated validity range is emitted. This is a measured limit (not projection); design-sensitivity projections (e.g. 3e-16 GeV^-1) also discussed but not emitted. DM density assumed rho_a = 0.4 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 2))
